info.description: This is a robust e-commerce backend API.
info.title: Go Marketplace API

post.description: Authenticates a user and returns access and refresh tokens.
Creates a new user account with email, password, and username.
Allows an authenticated user to register their own shop/merchant profile.

get.description: Checks connectivity to the database and Supabase configuration.

put.description: Allows the shop owner to cancel an order and initiate a refund.
Allows the shop owner to change the lifecycle status of an order (e.g., to SHIPPED).

post.description: Creates a new product for a specific merchant store.

get.description: Searches for products using full-text search and fuzzy matching.

put.description: Updates the details of an existing product.

get.description: Returns all saved address templates for the authenticated user.

post.description: Creates a new address template for the authenticated user.

put.description: Modifies an existing address template for the authenticated user.

delete.description: Removes an address template from the user's saved addresses.

get.description: Fetches all items in the authenticated user's shopping cart along with the total price.

post.description: Adds a specified quantity of a product to the authenticated user's cart.

delete.description: Deletes all products from the authenticated user's shopping cart.

put.description: Updates the quantity of a specific product already in the user's cart.

delete.description: Removes a specific product from the authenticated user's cart.

get.description: Fetches the authenticated user profile details.

post.description: Converts the current items in the authenticated user's cart into a formal order.

get.description: Fetches full information for a specific order by its ID.

post.description: Submits a formal appeal for an order, typically for disputes.

put.description: Cancels a pending or processing order and initiates a refund if applicable.

get.description: Fetches the authenticated user's digital wallet information.

post.description: Creates a new digital wallet for the authenticated user.

get.description: Fetches a paginated list of transactions for the user's wallet.

post.description: Deducts funds from the user's wallet balance.

BearerAuth.description: Type "Bearer" followed by a space and then your token.
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
